tools.name: introspect-admin-schema
tools.description: Introspect the Shopify Admin GraphQL schema. Only use this for the Shopify Admin API, not for other APIs like Storefront API or Functions API.

query.description: Search term to filter schema elements by name. Only pass simple terms like 'product', 'discountProduct', etc.

filter.description: Filter results to show specific sections. Can include 'types', 'queries', 'mutations', or 'all' (default)

prompt.description: The search query for Shopify documentation
